$comment: `__int128` / `unsigned __int128` — the 128-bit STANDARD-RANK integer type (D-CSUBSET-UINT128-TYPE). The runnable twin of the `_BitInt(128)` corpus: same 2-limb by-address substrate, DIFFERENT type identity and DIFFERENT alignment (16, not the psABI's bit-precise 8). Re-implements the ACTUAL shapes of sqlite's `sqlite3Multiply128` / `sqlite3Multiply160` (sqlite/src/util.c, the SQLITE_USE_UINT128 arm) — which is what the corpus probe broke on. Every operand is a RUNTIME value (volatile-seeded) so no const-fold pre-evaluates the wide arithmetic, and every product is chosen to have a NON-ZERO HIGH WORD (a product that fits in 64 bits passes even with a completely dead high limb). RED-ON-DISABLE: t1 — a `return (u64)(r>>64);` from a HELPER function that drops the wide→narrow truncation, or reads limb 0 where limb 1 is meant; t2 — the Multiply160 shape, whose wide `+=` must carry INTO the high limb, whose `>>32` middle word is truncated to u32 THROUGH A POINTER, and whose wide→u64 return is IMPLICIT (a narrowing applied only at explicit `(T)` casts breaks it); t3 — a BY-VALUE 128-bit param and 128-bit return, an array element and a struct member (a one-register by-value arg, or an aggregate-width Load/Store, keeps only the low 8 bytes); t4 — truncating casts to u64 AND u32 off limb 0, >>32 and >>64; t5 — the SIGNED counterpart: negative value, `/`, `%` taking the DIVIDEND's sign (C99 6.5.5p6), an ARITHMETIC (sign-propagating) `>>`, and `<`; t6 — the width probes in NON-VACUOUS form, since `(__uint128_t)-1 == 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFull` is MEASURED to pass with the type mistyped as u64 (it is kept only as an explicitly-labelled NEGATIVE control, asserted FALSE); t7 — the four 64-bit C SPELLINGS (`unsigned long long`, `unsigned long`, `long long`, `long`) each narrowed in a HELPER RETURN, which is exactly the class that regressed: C spells four distinct 64-bit type names over only two kinds, so a narrowing typed from the KIND instead of the DECLARED TypeId walls with I_TerminatorTypeMismatch — and the sub-64-bit widths do NOT cover it, because C gives those kinds one spelling each and their declared TypeId happens to BE the canonical primitive. Each term is boolean-gated ⇒ the sum is 42 only when every one holds. Data-model agnostic: the `long` / `unsigned long` expectations are written as CASTS of the full 64-bit constant, so the LLP64 (32-bit `long`) and LP64 legs both hold. The COMPILE-TIME `_Static_assert` block (sizeof 16, _Alignof 16 — THE discriminator against a `_BitInt(128)` binding, which is align 8 and must stay 8 — and `sizeof(struct N)==528`, whose `_BitInt(128)` twin is MEASURED at 520) is deliberately NOT wired into the exit code: a failed static assert aborts translation, so a term computed from one could never report a runtime failure. 128-bit arithmetic is materialized by ADDRESS (never a bare SSA aggregate), so the release arm's mem2reg/const-fold preserve the multiply carry chains and still exit 42. t9 (P42) — THE FOUR MATERIALIZATION SITES THE FIRST ROSTER LEFT OUT, plus the `(_Bool)` witness. D-CSUBSET-INT128-NARROWING-CAST-SITE-INCOMPLETE lists SEVEN contexts a wide value can be narrowed into; t1..t7 covered return, assignment, initializer, pointer store, struct MEMBER store and array-element store, and t9 adds the rest — CALL ARGUMENT, COMPOUND ASSIGNMENT, STRUCT BRACE-INITIALIZER and TERNARY — because that row's own lesson is that a suite over a SUBSET of a multi-site contract is not proof of the contract, which is exactly how the defect shipped. Each uses a 64-bit SPELLING (`unsigned long long` / `unsigned long` / `long`), the four names over two kinds that make a declared TypeId differ from the canonical primitive; the sub-64-bit widths structurally cannot see the class. ★ The ternary arm also carries the `(_Bool)` witness and is the shape that found the defect: `c ? (_Bool)(w>>64) : (_Bool)0` walled with `L_UnsupportedLoweringForOpcode Trunc result: TypeKind ordinal 0`, because the `(_Bool)0` arm took HIR->MIR's `mapCast`, which classifies `_Bool` as an 8-bit integer and so turned an int->`_Bool` conversion into a WIDTH TRUNCATION keeping only the low bit. Both `_Bool` probes here are EVEN values with a TRUE truth value (one has a zero low LIMB, one a zero low BIT), so a truncating `(_Bool)` answers false and t9 — a MULTIPLICATIVE gate like t8 — drives the exit to 0 rather than rebalancing t1..t7.
